description: Fetch data for ONE INE series by its code. Use nult=N for the last N periods, or date="YYYYMMDD:" for from that date on. Returns the series with its Data[] array of {Fecha (epoch ms), Anyo, Valor} points.

date.description: Date filter, e.g. "20250101:" for from Jan 2025 onward.

nult.description: Return the last N periods (default 12 if no date given).

name: series_data
title: Series Data
